verdict.rationale: Finix documents automated reports covering transactions, disputes and fees in a dashboard, plus a Payouts Dashboard for managing payout activity. These cover part of the reconciliation-report need. However, nothing shows that sellers themselves can reach per-seller statements or exports without going through the platform operator. Missing for 10: seller-facing self-serve portal, per-seller statements, documented payout reconciliation reports, export formats for bookkeepers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me

citations.quote: From transactions to disputes and fees, more than 10 report types are automated and available in your personal dashboard
Learn how to manage your payout activity using the Payouts Dashboard.
You can manage how sellers get paid out using the Finix Dashboard or our API.
